scope: The standing main house at Drayton Hall near Charleston as photographed in 2008, including the land-side double portico, raised terrace, red roof and river-side entrance.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: HABS measures the seven-bay rectangular body and northeast porch. It records Flemish-bond brick, raised basement, four lower Doric and four upper Ionic columns, paired stairs, red double-pitched hipped roof and paired chimneys.
The national register entry describes the two-story land portico and unprojected river facade with its central pediment.
The preservation trust identifies the main house on the estate.
